title: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: A framework for dynamic scene reconstruction that uses adaptive space-time densification to model complex oscillatory motions such as vegetation in wind or water ripples. It achieves high-fidelity 4D rendering by refining primitives based on motion variance and error moments.
research_notes: Introduced a weighted Adam optimizer and image-driven as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) regularization now widely used in real-time VR/AR rendering pipelines.

evolution.summary: Evolved from static 3DGS (2023) and fixed-interval 4DGS (2024) into an adaptive densification model presented at Eurographics 2026. It replaces rigid temporal intervals with motion-aware refinement, significantly improving performance on stochastic dynamic scenes.
